patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero section featuring a large, prominent brand logo and tagline on the left, balanced by a dynamic collage of images with rounded corners on the right.

A distinctive brand palette combining a deep forest green for branding elements, a warm yellow for interactive components, and a light, creamy off-white for backgrounds, accented by a bright orange and light blue for promotional banners.
Bold, large sans-serif typography is used for headings and the primary brand identity, creating a strong visual presence, complemented by a clean, readable sans-serif for body text.

A transforming sticky header that shrinks in height and changes its background color and content layout upon scroll, and a search bar that slides up from the bottom of the viewport as the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Content sections frequently employ a two-column layout, pairing descriptive text with either a unique graphic illustration or a grid of image-based content cards with consistent rounded corners.

technique_notes: The header implements a scroll-triggered transformation: initially a full-height promotional banner and separate navigation, it collapses into a compact, sticky bar with a changed background and integrated CTA as the user scrolls down. This effect is likely achieved using CSS keyframes or JavaScript to modify element styles and classes based on scroll position.
A prominent search bar is revealed with a slide-up animation from the bottom of the screen as the user scrolls past the initial hero content, then scrolls away again with further page depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and smaller labels, maintaining a clear visual hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded corners are consistently applied to images, buttons, and input fields, contributing to a soft, approachable, and modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and balanced spacing, particularly in the hero and main content sections, providing ample whitespace around elements for clarity and a relaxed feel.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, green brand identity combined with a warm, inviting color palette and consistently rounded elements, creating a unique blend of modern minimalism and playful approachability. The dynamic, transforming sticky header and the sliding search bar add a layer of interactive sophistication.
